# Instanced Draw Tests

## Overview

Tests for Vulkan instanced drawing functionality, verifying that instanced draw commands (`vkCmdDraw`, `vkCmdDrawIndexed`, `vkCmdDrawIndirect`, `vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirect`) correctly render multiple instances with proper per-instance vertex attribute advancement. The tests cover various primitive topologies, vertex attribute divisors (via `VK_EXT_vertex_attribute_divisor` and `VK_KHR_vertex_attribute_divisor`), multiview rendering, dynamic vertex input state, `VK_KHR_maintenance5` index buffer binding, and `VK_KHR_device_address_commands` buffer binding variants.

## Role

Validates that instanced draw calls correctly advance instance-rate vertex attributes based on the instance index and divisor. Ensures that `gl_InstanceIndex` in the vertex shader reflects the correct instance number, including non-zero `firstInstance` values when the `drawIndirectFirstInstance` feature is supported. Tests that vertex attribute divisors control how instance-rate attributes are consumed across instances, including divisor values of 0 (all instances share the same attribute value), 1 (default per-instance), and higher values. Verifies that multiview rendering correctly renders to multiple layers with instanced draws. Exercises alternative buffer binding commands introduced by `VK_KHR_maintenance5` (`vkCmdBindIndexBuffer2KHR`) and `VK_KHR_device_address_commands` (`vkCmdBindIndexBuffer3KHR`, `vkCmdBindVertexBuffers3KHR`, `vkCmdDrawIndirect2KHR`, `vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirect2KHR`).

## Test Families

### draw_* — Direct instanced draw tests

Tests using `vkCmdDraw` with various primitive topologies. Each test iterates over multiple instance counts (0, 1, 2, 4, 20) and first instance indices (0, 1, 3, 4, 20). Vertex attributes include per-vertex position/color and per-instance color, with the instance color offset by `gl_InstanceIndex / instanceCount`.

### draw_indexed_* — Indexed instanced draw tests

Tests using `vkCmdDrawIndexed` with various primitive topologies. Uses an index buffer to reference vertices. Same instance count and first instance iteration as direct draw tests.

### draw_indirect_* — Indirect instanced draw tests

Tests using `vkCmdDrawIndirect` with a buffer containing `VkDrawIndirectCommand` structures. The `firstInstance` field is set based on the current iteration. When `drawIndirectFirstInstance` is not supported, only `firstInstance = 0` is tested.

### draw_indexed_indirect_* — Indexed indirect instanced draw tests

Tests using `vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirect` with a buffer containing `VkDrawIndexedIndirectCommand` structures. Combines indexed and indirect draw semantics with instancing.

### *_attrib_divisor_* — Vertex attribute divisor tests

Tests with `VK_EXT_vertex_attribute_divisor` or `VK_KHR_vertex_attribute_divisor` enabled, using divisor values of 0, 1, 2, 4, and 20. Divisor 0 means all instances share the same attribute value; divisor N means the attribute advances once every N instances.

### *_multiview — Multiview instanced draw tests

Tests with multiview rendering enabled (2 layers, view mask 0x3). Only generated when vertex attribute divisor is `ATTRIBUTE_DIVISOR_NONE` (no divisor extension), to avoid combinatorial explosion.

### *_maintenance_5 — Maintenance5 index buffer binding tests

Tests using `vkCmdBindIndexBuffer2KHR` (from `VK_KHR_maintenance5`) instead of `vkCmdBindIndexBuffer` for indexed and indexed-indirect draw functions. Only generated for indexed draw variants.

### *_device_address — Device address buffer binding tests

Tests using `vkCmdBindIndexBuffer3KHR`, `vkCmdBindVertexBuffers3KHR`, and `vkCmdDrawIndirect2KHR`/`vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirect2KHR` from `VK_KHR_device_address_commands`. Tests mix-and-match of old and new binding commands. Only generated for divisor values 0 and 1, with reduced permutations for dynamic state cases.

### dynamic_state_* — Dynamic vertex input state tests

Tests with `VK_EXT_vertex_input_dynamic_state` enabled, using `vkCmdSetVertexInputEXT` to set vertex input state dynamically at command buffer recording time instead of at pipeline creation time. Reduced topology coverage (only `triangle_strip`) to limit test count.

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Values | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| Draw function | `FUNCTION_DRAW`, `FUNCTION_DRAW_INDEXED`, `FUNCTION_DRAW_INDIRECT`, `FUNCTION_DRAW_INDEXED_INDIRECT` | The Vulkan draw command used |
| Topology | `POINT_LIST`, `LINE_LIST`, `LINE_STRIP`, `TRIANGLE_LIST`, `TRIANGLE_STRIP`, `TRIANGLE_FAN` | Primitive topology |
| Attribute divisor extension | `ATTRIBUTE_DIVISOR_NONE`, `ATTRIBUTE_DIVISOR_EXT`, `ATTRIBUTE_DIVISOR_KHR` | Which vertex attribute divisor extension to use |
| Divisor value | 0, 1, 2, 4, 20 | Instance rate divisor value (1 = default per-instance; 0 = all instances share same value) |
| Multiview | false, true | Whether multiview rendering is enabled (2 layers) |
| Dynamic state | false, true | Whether `VK_EXT_vertex_input_dynamic_state` is used |
| Maintenance5 | false, true | Whether `vkCmdBindIndexBuffer2KHR` is used |
| Device address commands | false, true | Whether `VK_KHR_device_address_commands` binding/draw variants are used |
| Instance count | 0, 1, 2, 4, 20 | Number of instances (iterated at runtime) |
| First instance | 0, 1, 3, 4, 20 | First instance index (iterated at runtime; limited to 0 when `drawIndirectFirstInstance` unsupported) |

## Verification Methods

- **Fuzzy image comparison against software reference renderer**: A reference image is generated using the software renderer (`rr::Renderer`) with a custom vertex shader (`TestVertShader` at [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L191-L228](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L191-L228)) that applies the same per-instance offset and color computation as the GPU shader. The rendered output is compared using `tcu::fuzzyCompare` with a threshold of 0.05 for non-point topologies at [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L883-L885](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L883-L885), and `tcu::intThresholdPositionDeviationCompare` with a color threshold of 4 and position deviation of (1,1,0) for point lists at [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L871-L876](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L871-L876).
- **Multiview layer-by-layer comparison**: When multiview is enabled, each layer is read and compared independently against the same reference image at [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L857-L887](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L857-L887).

## Notes

- Test names are generated dynamically by the `operator<<` overload for `TestParams` at [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L103-L139](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L103-L139), encoding the draw function, topology, divisor extension/value, and multiview status.
- The vertex shader uses `gl_InstanceIndex` with push constants for `firstInstance` and `instanceCount` to compute per-instance offsets at [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L326-L345](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L326-L345).
- Test count is reduced for dynamic rendering with secondary command buffers by skipping certain topology and divisor combinations at [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L1238-L1241](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L1238-L1241) and [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L1248-L1251](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L1248-L1251).
- When `ATTRIBUTE_DIVISOR_NONE` is used, only divisor value 1 is tested (no divisor extension available) at [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L1256-L1257](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L1256-L1257).
- Multiview tests are only generated when vertex attribute divisor is `ATTRIBUTE_DIVISOR_NONE` to avoid excessive test count at [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L1272-L1273](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L1272-L1273).
- The reference renderer treats divisor 0 as per-vertex; `INT_MAX` is used instead for the reference at [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L830-L833](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L830-L833).
- Device address command tests mix and match old and new binding commands based on `(topology + attribDivisor) % 3` at [vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L1028-L1031](../../../modules/vulkan/draw/vktDrawInstancedTests.cpp#L1028-L1031).
